changes.comment: A saved entry no longer warns about unsaved changes when leaving. The rich text editor fires transactions that change nothing stored — normalising the parsed document on mount, and re-parsing after a save reloads the entry — and its serialization differs from the server's stored form by a trailing newline, so each of those emits marked a clean form dirty. The field now emits only when the value it would emit actually differs from the one it holds.
